description: Finds and decodes every QR code, Micro QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417 and 1D barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 128/39/93, ITF, Codabar, DataBar) in a PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP image, and explains the content: Wi-Fi login, contact card, event, payment, GS1 fields, product code or link (with its domain).
name: code_read
title: Read QR codes and barcodes
